ideas.what: Build and score the no-insertion twin of K2, exp58n = x138 + safetail + lowrefine (the branch-B command already in CONTEXT.md: python tools/build_probe_kernel.py exp58n_x138_safe_lowref --base x138 --patch safetail --patch lowrefine --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200 --set LOWREFINE_ENABLE=1). Submit it in the S3 slot, which branch A leaves unused (26 Sep ~00:30-01:00 UTC, after K2), or at the latest in S9 on 27 Sep. If forkmid is accepted into F1 (K3), rebuild the twin as exp59n = K3 minus divinsert in S9, so the twin is always F1 minus the insertion. The twin becomes the default F2 in place of exp52 (see idea finals-pair-calculator).
ideas.why_now: The objective under this lens is the x138 cliff. From the 16:52 UTC LB (wf_ideas_v4/intel_browser.notes.md): the 0.953 block holds ranks 193-448, verbatim x138 sits at #228, and about 220 teams are at or below raw x138. Bronze is about rank 390 of 3,904 and silver about 195. A private score even epsilon above X (x138's private score) therefore means rank <= ~230, a near-certain medal. Epsilon below X means rank >= ~450, no medal. The plan's F2 = exp52 hedges this cliff badly. Its public score is 0.003 below X, and it shares both the V1284 head and a DaughterNet insertion with F1, so it tends to fail in the same worlds as F1's riskiest component. F1's delta vs X on private is dominated by the insertion: +0.001 on the LB twice (#28 vs #27, #35 vs #34), 12 forks and 5 steals on the dummies, and a private break-even precision of 0.11-0.20. A twin without the insertion keeps F2 above X exactly in the world where the insertion is negative on the private embryo. The time argument for exp52 is also gone. The limit is 12 h, x138's runtime is <= 6.46 h, and the twin runs about as long as x138 (lowrefine adds seconds) against its 9.5 h deadline. That leaves about 3 h of margin, versus K2's ~7.8 h forecast (step0.md).
ideas.evidence: Monte Carlo (scratchpad finals_mc.py, logged in research/wf_ideas_v4/lens_private-finals.notes.md). Private deltas vs X (guesses anchored on v3 section c): insertion I ~ N(+0.0008, 0.0008), lowrefine L ~ N(+0.00015, 0.0003), forkmid M ~ N(+0.0005, 0.0006); exp52 = -0.003 + N(0, 0.003) with corr 0.3 to I; silver line S = X + N(0.0005, 0.0005). With F1 = I+L+M: P(max > X) is 0.918 with no hedge, 0.924 with exp52, 0.927 with exp48, 0.940 with near-copy K2, and 0.950 with the twin L+M. P(max > S) is 0.795 / 0.806 / 0.810 / 0.821 / 0.824 in the same order. If the insertion is riskier on private (mean +0.0005, sd 0.0012): exp52 0.815 vs twin 0.924. With exp52's spread at 0.004: 0.926 vs 0.950. Sources: experiments/RESULTS.md probes 27/28/34/35 (insertion +0.001 twice; exp57b nodes identical to exp56); research/wf_ideas_v3/v_ensembles-and-private_finals-private-emax-x138-era_value.json (exp52 premium only +0.00006..+0.0005, P(it counts) 0.07-0.23); experiments/runtime_step0/step0.md; CONTEXT.md 25 Sep 17:20 (K2 dummy counters).
ideas.expected_gain: 0 on public. About +0.03 P(medal) (0.918 -> 0.950) in the base case and up to +0.11 if the insertion is riskier on private. Expected private score +0.00007 vs exp52: not a score idea, a rank insurance for the bronze/no-medal cliff.

ideas.test_gate: Dummy gate (reuse tools/dummy_gates.py K2 checks): 'Low-detection dump applied'; LOWDET == exp56 per clip; LOWREFINE refined counts == K2 dummy exactly (26,532 / 33,336 / 7,370 / 76,396); readmit 1,365 and gapfill 111 == K2; node rows byte-identical to K2 dummy, since the insertion is the last edit and changes no nodes; edges differ from K2 only at K2's inserted forks; no DIVINS / DEADLINE / REPAIR FAILED / LOWREFINE FAILED lines. LB rule, pre-registered: admissible as F2 if error-free and public >= 0.953 (= #34). At 0.952 lowrefine is LB-negative: drop the twin and also re-check R3 for lowrefine in K2. ideas.risk: It uses one slot that is idle in branch A (S3). If forkmid enters F1 and exp59n is not rebuilt, the twin also differs from F1 by M. That is acceptable: F1 minus {I, M} is still a valid hedge, with P(>X) about 0.93 instead of 0.95. Lowrefine is shared by both files, so the twin does not hedge lowrefine's sign (P(>=0) 0.6-0.8, magnitude ~0.0002). Low risk: no new code.

ideas.what: Replace section f's 'F2 = exp52 by default, a variant only if all five conditions hold' with a pre-registered PAIR rule. Among the scored, R5-admissible x138-family files with C01 (plus exp52 and exp48 as candidates), choose the two files {A, B} that maximise U = P(max(A,B) > X) + P(max(A,B) > S). Compute U with a small committed script (tools/finals_mc.py; the scratchpad version has 30 lines). It uses a component table (mean, sd of each rider's private delta vs X) frozen before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC (R8). In practice the rule reduces to: (1) if a variance rider (the DeepCenter threshold D or tempfuse T) is scored with public delta >= 0 and passed its honest gate, the pair is {stack without it, stack with it}. Both files are already scored in the cumulative K-stack, so no extra slot is needed. (2) Otherwise the pair is {F1, F1 minus insertion} (idea noins-twin-f2). (3) exp52 only if no admissible x138-family pair exists (branch D). Which file is labelled F1 does not matter, because U is symmetric.
ideas.why_now: Three facts make v3's section f conditions stale. (a) Time risk is small now: 12 h limit, not 9 h; L34 <= 6.46 h; K2 forecast ~7.8 h with a 9.5 h deadline. So 'exp52 has no timer' no longer buys anything. (b) Rank is a step function: the ~220 exact copies of x138 make P(> X) the bronze/no-medal decision, and silver (~rank 195) sits about +0.0005 above X on public. (c) The MC shows that the PAIR, not the F1 label, decides U, and that a mean-neutral high-variance variant paired with its twin beats every structurally different hedge. Tuning neither file on public is still required. The table uses public deltas only as shrunk means.
ideas.evidence: scratchpad finals_mc2.py (logged in the notes). D ~ N(+0.0005, 0.0015) on private: {ILM, ILMD} P(>X) / P(>S) = 0.960 / 0.889; {ILM, twin LM} 0.951 / 0.823; {ILM, exp52} 0.932 / 0.815; {ILMD, exp52} 0.881 / 0.804. D with private mean 0: {ILM, ILMD} 0.949 / 0.865, still above {ILM, exp52} 0.931 / 0.816. exp48 as a head-collapse hedge is rejected on numbers. In experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt, heads trained on one embryo still beat NO head on the other: 6bba->44b6 1.452 vs 1.499 um, 44b6->6bba 1.570 vs 1.720 um, and 7-um matches are unchanged (20,106 vs 20,112; 112,260 vs 112,254). So P(x138 cluster falls below the 0.947 block on private) is ~0.01-0.02, and exp48 is worth ~0.01 P(medal). LB blocks and medal lines: research/wf_ideas_v4/intel_browser.json (rank-arithmetic-watch). Rules 3.7.b tie = earlier submission applies only to byte-identical files (CONTEXT.md 13:58 UTC).
ideas.expected_gain: 0 on public. +0.02..+0.08 P(medal) vs the exp52 default, depending on which riders score. Expected private score +0.0001..+0.0008 via E[max].
ideas.test_gate: Pre-register the table and the script in CONTEXT.md before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC. Freeze the sd values from the exp60 lab: for each rider, sd_private = max(prior sd, |delta_44b6 - delta_6bba| on the SELECTION+CONFIRMATION clips), and mean = 0.5 x public delta (shrinkage). ideas.what: Use the pair logic for the remaining slots. (1) The variant (K3b DeepCenter threshold, K4 tempfuse) is submitted as K-stack + variant, never as a stand-alone rebuild, so its twin without the variant is already scored. (2) If both D and T pass their gates, do NOT consolidate them into one F1-final (S12). Keep them as separate one-rider files, so the calculator can pair the harmless stack with the higher-variance variant; a 2-rider file has a higher sd, but its twin is not scored. (3) Freeze insertion ON in every K build: the twin only needs one leave-out slot.
ideas.why_now: In the MC, U grows with the pair's spread as long as the variant's private mean is >= 0. Consolidating riders into one file (S12) removes the leave-one-out twin the pair needs. The cumulative-stack order (K2 -> K3 -> K3b/K4) already produces the twins for free. The only slot it costs is the insertion twin (idea noins-twin-f2), because insertion entered at the base.
ideas.evidence: research/wf_ideas_v3/FINAL_REPORT.md section e slots S4-S6, S12 (consolidation only if riders sit in different files); finals_mc2.py rows {ILM, ILMD} vs {ILMD, LM}: 0.960 / 0.889 vs 0.952 / 0.851 (leaving out only the variant beats leaving out two components).
ideas.expected_gain: +0.01..+0.04 P(silver) in the worlds where D or T is scored with delta >= 0 (P ~0.3-0.4). 0 otherwise.
ideas.runtime_cost: 0 (no new file content; tempfuse, if built, adds its own ~0.2-0.5 h, well within the ~4 h headroom)
ideas.test_gate: The same dummy and R3/R4 gates as in v3; this changes only which files are consolidated and ticked. S12 fires only if the calculator says the consolidated file would enter the argmax pair.
ideas.risk: Leaving riders unconsolidated forgoes a slightly higher E[F1] (+0.0005 if both are positive). The calculator can show when consolidation wins, so no fixed rule is needed.

plan_critique: Under the private/finals lens the v3 section f default F2 = exp52 should change. The new facts are the 12 h limit, L34 <= 6.46 h, K2 at ~7.8 h vs a 9.5 h deadline, ~220 exact copies of x138 at or below raw x138 (ranks 193-448), and bronze at ~390. So the finals objective is P(max(F1,F2) > X), the bronze/no-medal cliff, plus P(> silver line ~X+0.0005). exp52 is the weakest hedge of that cliff. It is 0.003 below X on public and shares the V1284 head and a DaughterNet insertion with F1, so it fails with F1. MC: +0.006 P(>X) for exp52 vs +0.032 for the no-insertion twin and +0.04 for a {stack, stack+variance-rider} pair. Its 'no timer' rationale is void at a ~3-4 h runtime margin. exp48 (head-free) also fails as a cluster-collapse hedge: heads trained on one embryo still beat no head on the other (coordhead report), so P(collapse) is ~0.01-0.02. Concretely: (1) spend the idle S3 slot (or S9) on exp58n = K2 without insertion, and rebuild it as exp59n if forkmid joins F1. (2) Replace section f's five-condition variant rule with the pre-registered pair calculator, frozen by 27 Sep 12:00, with exp52 only as the branch-D fallback. (3) Do not consolidate variance riders in S12 unless the calculator prefers it. Keep the rest: branch A, K2 at 00:01, R3/R4 on public, manual ticking, never exp56. Minor points. (a) The 8.0 h insertion gate has only ~0.2 h of worst-case margin. If it fires, the last private clips get no insertion, which moves F1 toward the twin, so there is nothing to fix. (b) The 'late copy ranks at the end of the block' warning concerns only byte-identical files. Within a displayed score the order follows the unrounded score (intel_browser), which is why sub-0.001 riders count for silver. (c) The v3 private-premium numbers (+0.0002..+0.0005) measure score, not rank. At a medal cliff, P(>X) is the right unit.
